follow-up time: Until full maturity of their retina
exposure: Infants with birth weight less than 1.5 kg
outcome: Cumulative incidence of retinopathy of prematurity (ROP)
cohort: 401 preterm infants with birth weight less than 2 kg or gestational age less than 37 weeks admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) of Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital (KBTH) from June 2018 to February 2019
finding: The cumulative incidence of retinopathy of prematurity (ROP) was 13.7%, and increased risk of ROP was observed in babies with supplemental oxygen exposure, birth weight less than 1.5 kg, confirmed neonatal sepsis, nasogastric tube feeding and poor pupillary dilation, while a reduced risk was observed in boys and after delivery by caesarean section.
mod_finding: Infants delivered by caesarean section had a reduced risk of ROP.
